stories.title: Russia reports mass cyberattacks targeting elections

en.title: Russia reports mass cyberattacks targeting elections
en.summary: Russia's electoral chief reported over 1,000 waves of distributed denial-of-service attacks against election infrastructure in recent days. DDoS attacks work by overwhelming systems with internet traffic to disrupt normal functioning.

stories.title: Sudan Gold Mine Collapse Kills 10, Injures 21

en.title: Sudan Gold Mine Collapse Kills 10, Injures 21
en.summary: A gold mine collapse in Sudan resulted in at least 10 deaths and 21 injuries.

stories.title: Sudan gold mine collapse kills 10, injures 21: survivors

en.title: Sudan gold mine collapse kills 10, injures 21: survivors
en.summary: A gold mine collapse in northern Sudan caused at least 10 deaths and 21 injuries. Sudan's gold trade has served as a significant funding source during the country's ongoing conflict.

stories.title: PIF launches Tawrid platform to expand supply-chain financing

en.title: PIF launches Tawrid platform to expand supply-chain financing
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund launched Tawrid, a digital platform connecting buyers, suppliers, and funders to offer supply-chain financing products. The platform aims to help companies improve working-capital efficiency and strengthen local supply chains.

stories.title: Kingdom committed to international peace, security, FM affirms

en.title: Kingdom committed to international peace, security, FM affirms
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister stated that the Kingdom's participation in the UN General Assembly demonstrates its commitment to international peace and security through dialogue, mediation, and addressing shared global challenges.

stories.title: Arab Parliament Condemns Houthi Militia Attack Targeting Riyadh

en.title: Arab Parliament Condemns Houthi Militia Attack Targeting Riyadh
en.summary: The Arab Parliament issued a condemnation of a Houthi militia attack directed at Riyadh.

stories.title: UN, GCC chiefs condemn Houthi militia attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying serious threat to regional security

en.title: UN, GCC chiefs condemn Houthi militia attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying serious threat to regional security
en.summary: The UN Secretary General and GCC Secretary General condemned Houthi militia attacks on Saudi Arabia targeting civilian sites, characterizing them as a severe threat to regional peace and security.

stories.title: Saudi FM Highlights Saudi Arabia’s Commitment to International Peace and Security

en.title: Saudi FM Highlights Saudi Arabia's Commitment to International Peace and Security
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister emphasized the country's dedication to international peace and security.

stories.title: Arab and Islamic world condemns Houthi attacks; affirms support for Saudi Arabia

en.title: Arab and Islamic world condemns Houthi attacks; affirms support for Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Multiple Arab nations and Islamic organizations condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, including a ballistic missile attempt on Riyadh and strikes on civilian areas. Yemen, Kuwait, Egypt, Bahrain, Lebanon, and Jordan issued statements expressing solidarity with Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: UN Security Council Condemns Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.title: UN Security Council Condemns Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The UN Security Council issued a condemnation of Houthi attacks directed at Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: 2 Dead in Mass Drone Barrage on Moscow Aiming to 'Disrupt' Russia's Elections

en.title: 2 Dead in Mass Drone Barrage on Moscow Aiming to 'Disrupt' Russia's Elections
en.summary: A mass drone attack on Moscow resulted in two deaths. The attack was reportedly intended to disrupt Russia's electoral processes.

stories.title: Arab countries condemn Houthi attack on Saudi capital

en.title: Arab countries condemn Houthi attack on Saudi capital
en.summary: Arab League members condemned Iranian-backed Houthi rebels for launching attacks on Riyadh, including a ballistic missile that was intercepted. The group has continued targeting Saudi Arabia with missiles and drones.

en.title: Tadawul: Major ownership changes on Sept. 16
en.summary: The Saudi Exchange reported significant ownership changes occurring on September 16.

stories.title: ‎Foreign institutions net sellers of SAR 1.1B on TASI last week

en.title: Foreign institutions net sellers of SAR 1.1B on TASI last week
en.summary: Foreign institutions sold more TASI stocks than they purchased during the week ending September 17, with net sales of approximately 1.1 billion Saudi riyals. Saudi institutional investors were net buyers during the same period.

stories.title: ‎VLCC shipping rates top $1M/day, Bahri likely to benefit

en.title: VLCC shipping rates top $1M/day, Bahri likely to benefit
en.summary: Very Large Crude Carrier shipping rates have reached record levels, exceeding $1 million per day on major Middle Eastern routes to Asia due to increased transit risks and limited vessel availability. Saudi shipping company Bahri is positioned to benefit from these elevated rates.

stories.title: ‎2P increases SAR 376.2M credit facility with BSF

en.title: 2P increases SAR 376.2M credit facility with BSF
en.summary: Perfect Presentation for Commercial Services increased its Shariah-compliant banking facility with Banque Saudi Fransi to SAR 376.19 million, with financing extending to September 2027. The facility will support new project contracts and trade finance operations.

stories.title: ‎TASI falls 0.3% to 10,750 pts, turnover at SAR 2.6B

en.title: TASI falls 0.3% to 10,750 pts, turnover at SAR 2.6B
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's main stock index declined 0.3% to close at 10,750 points with trading volume of SAR 2.6 billion.
